title: How a Pile of Rocks Becomes a Foundation
script: If you dump rocks on the mud and stack a wall on them, you have a foundation. But the wall sinks into the ground, so you pour a concrete slab under it. But soft dirt squeezes out from underneath, so you drive steel piles down to solid rock. But concrete cracks when it bends, so you bury steel bars inside it. Add anchor bolts and a rubber seal. Congratulations, you have built a foundation.
